## Life
- [Aletsch Glacier](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/life/aletsch-glacier/): A trip out to the Aletsch Glacier, the largest in the Alps.
- [Travelling in Switzerland](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/life/switzerland-travel/): Getting around Switzerland during the NCCR SPIN collaboration in Basel.
- [Badminton](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/life/badminton/): Doubles at the sports hall.
- [Bouldering](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/life/bouldering/): Weekly sessions at the local gym.
- [Football](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/life/football/): Kickabouts and five-a-side games.
- [Swimming](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/life/swimming/): Lengths at the pool to clear my head.
- [Travelling in Canada](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/life/canada-travel/): Exploring Canada during the research residency at IQC in Waterloo.

## Papers & Research
- [Spin Qubit 7](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/research/spin-qubit-7-netherlands/): The seventh Spin Qubit International Conference.
- [NCCR SPIN](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/research/nccr-spin-collaboration/): Research collaboration on advanced spin-based quantum architectures.
- [Quantum Papers Aggregator](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/research/papers-aggregator/): A serverless tool that collects the latest quantum computing and spin qubit papers from arXiv, refreshed every morning.
- [Institute for Quantum Computing, University of Waterloo](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/research/iqc-waterloo-residency/): Three-month research residency on the evaluation and modelling of fabricated qubits.
- [KAUST Academy AI Summer Internship](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/research/kaust-academy-ai-internship/): Summer research internship in artificial intelligence with the KAUST Academy.

## Books
- [Quantum Mechanics](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/books/quantum_mechanics/): Long-form notes on quantum mechanics. In progress.
- [Statistical Mechanics](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/books/statistical_mechanics/): Long-form notes on statistical mechanics. In progress.

## Posts
- [Dynamics of Spin Qubits in Semiconductor Quantum Dots](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/posts/spin-qubits-intro/): A brief overview of spin qubit Hamiltonian dynamics and gate implementations.
- [Energy Efficiency in Reversible Quantum Circuits](https://0xR101.github.io/my_personal_website/posts/reversible-computing-effeciency/): Analyzing the thermodynamic limits of computation through reversible logic gates.
